node.label: Places in news
node.summary: Locations that appeared in the news, for map-based questions.

facts.text: **Apure** (Venezuela), **Dammam** (Saudi Arabia), **Kherson** and **Oleshky** (Ukraine): sites of attacks in the world news.
facts.plain: Apure (Venezuela), Dammam (Saudi Arabia), Kherson and Oleshky (Ukraine): sites of attacks in the world news.

facts.text: **Jhunjhunu** (Rajasthan): eight labourers electrocuted when a machine touched an 11-kV line.
facts.plain: Jhunjhunu (Rajasthan): eight labourers electrocuted when a machine touched an 11-kV line.

facts.text: **Ravva oilfield**: offshore in the **Krishna-Godavari basin**, Andhra Pradesh (Vedanta arbitration).
facts.plain: Ravva oilfield: offshore in the Krishna-Godavari basin, Andhra Pradesh (Vedanta arbitration).

facts.text: Delhi CM **Rekha Gupta** announced a 3.3-km heritage corridor along Netaji Subhash Marg from Delhi Gate to Kashmere Gate, covering the Red Fort, St James' Church and Chandni Chowk, with a Heritage Interpretation Park planned at Delhi Gate.
facts.plain: Delhi CM Rekha Gupta announced a 3.3-km heritage corridor along Netaji Subhash Marg from Delhi Gate to Kashmere Gate, covering the Red Fort, St James' Church and Chandni Chowk, with a Heritage Interpretation Park planned at Delhi Gate.

facts.text: The Pacific Ocean was named 'Mar Pacifico' by **Ferdinand Magellan**; the International Date Line passes between Big and Little Diomede islands in the Bering Strait.
facts.plain: The Pacific Ocean was named 'Mar Pacifico' by Ferdinand Magellan; the International Date Line passes between Big and Little Diomede islands in the Bering Strait.

facts.text: Renaming a State needs a law of **Parliament under Article 3** (on the President's recommendation, after seeking the State legislature's views); it is not a constitutional amendment under Article 368. The Kerala Assembly had passed resolutions seeking 'Keralam'.
facts.plain: Renaming a State needs a law of Parliament under Article 3 (on the President's recommendation, after seeking the State legislature's views); it is not a constitutional amendment under Article 368. The Kerala Assembly had passed resolutions seeking 'Keralam'.

facts.text: Kerala now goes by **'Keralam'** — the State 'added an m to its name', as *The Hindu* noted; the paper now uses Keralam throughout.
facts.plain: Kerala now goes by 'Keralam' — the State 'added an m to its name', as The Hindu noted; the paper now uses Keralam throughout.

facts.text: Tamil Nadu's Secretariat functions from **Fort St. George**, Chennai; the TVK government has proposed a new Secretariat near the coast. The DMK's 2010 complex on Anna Salai is now the Omandurar hospital.
